scope: Current-canon implementation-gap design only: reconcile the existing first-forge, same-UID handoff, actual-use result, repair, and chronicle surfaces without importing foreign product expression or mutating product paths.

entries.source_and_evidence: User-supplied Google Play listing for com.patrick.legendsmith; public description and screenshot flow were reviewed on 2026-09-03 KST.
entries.observed_pattern: A short direct-forging action is followed by a workpiece leaving a forge context, receiving a use outcome, and returning to a record surface.
entries.project_fit_and_difference: ADAPT only the high-level clarity of craft-to-use-to-return. Do not reuse title, characters, world, assets, text, UI composition, ranking, advertising, or economy.

entries.source_and_evidence: Anvil Saga official Steam product page, reviewed 2026-09-03 KST.
entries.observed_pattern: The product couples blacksmith orders to workers, facilities, factions, relationships, and a broad shop-management economy.
entries.project_fit_and_difference: REJECT this expansion. Blacksmith keeps one current workpiece UID and factual actual-use return, without workers, factions, facilities, logistics, or a customer-management loop.

entries.source_and_evidence: Godot official Using Containers documentation, reviewed 2026-09-03 KST.
entries.observed_pattern: Container-derived nodes own child Control sizing and placement; nested containers support responsive layouts.
entries.project_fit_and_difference: ADOPT the implementation constraint: preserve established Container ownership and direct action NodePaths when clarifying handoff/report UI.

entries.source_and_evidence: Godot official Theme class documentation, reviewed 2026-09-03 KST.
entries.observed_pattern: Theme resources provide shared styling for a Control branch or project instead of scattering repeated local overrides.
entries.project_fit_and_difference: ADOPT only after a current Theme/local-override comparison; no new Theme resource or visual asset is implied by this design candidate.

project_only_lessons: A highly similar public loop can validate a player comprehension problem without authorizing reuse of its product expression.
Existing first-forge and same-UID return code should be reconciled before proposing a new minigame, customer roster, or new save schema.
A canonical but currently unreachable grade must be treated as a balance/meaning decision, not silently enabled through UI work.
